message.content:
**www.profedcreditunion.com** appears to be a misspelling of ProFed Credit Union’s official website, which is **profedcu.org**.[2] ProFed Credit Union is a credit union based in Fort Wayne, Indiana, with branches in northeast Indiana and membership eligibility tied to several Indiana counties.[2][3]

If you meant to reach the official site, use **profedcu.org**.[2]
